roleLabel: Late-payoff Duelist — Attack Speed snowball that detonates with Stall/Rush-scaled Gathering Storm
bestFor: Long fights and Duelist boards that can stack Attack Speed into a mid/late nuke
strength: Limitless gains AS every auto and amp damage after Stall; Gathering Storm scales with Stall and Rush counts this game
weakness: Slow start — early fights feel weak until AS and trigger counts build

howToPlay.early: Do not expect Act-open nukes. Buy Attack Speed and keep her alive. A tank buys the time Limitless needs.
howToPlay.mid: Electric/Limitless path = personal AS snowball. Mighty = Backup Duelist AS/Attack on every auto. Olympic = unique Zeus’s Thunder quest item. Pick solo carry, tribal Duelist, or quest item line.
howToPlay.late: Stack Stall and Rush triggers so Gathering Storm’s per-trigger damage is huge. Fury/Outbreak Duelist relics help the autos that feed Limitless.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid or safe side where she can auto freely. She needs uptime more than first-contact heroics.

abilityNotes.Gathering Storm: Damage per Stall and Rush triggered this game — the cast is a report card of your tempo. Trigger more, then cast.

specNotes.The Electric: Limitless AS carry identity — default when Irini is your late Duelist DPS.
specNotes.The Mighty: Team Duelist amp on autos. Take with multiple Duelists; weaker solo.
specNotes.The Olympic: Quest item path (Zeus’s Thunder). Take when you want that unique item line — otherwise prefer Electric/Mighty.

relicReasons.duelists-fury-filigree-3010: Feeds the Attack Speed aggression Limitless wants.
relicReasons.duelists-precise-reflection-629: Precision/Crit-leaning Duelist tool for late autos.

faq.question: Is Irini good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong late Duelist when fights last and AS stacks. Weak as a panic early carry. Buy her for snowball plans, not instant clear.

faq.question: What class is Irini?
faq.answer: Duelist. Role focus: Attack Speed scaler with Stall/Rush-powered Gathering Storm.

faq.question: What relics work with Irini?
faq.answer: Duelist Fury/Outbreak/Precise pieces, Attack Speed, and Stall/Rush enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Irini?
faq.answer: Protect her early, stack Attack Speed, trigger Stall/Rush through the run, then detonate Gathering Storm once counts are high.

tips: Judging Irini on fight one is wrong — check fight five after Limitless has stacked.
Mighty without other Duelists wastes Backup value; go Electric for solo.
